messages:
maria: Heads up — started a backfill for late telemetry slices and it leaked into the live routing window. Console is showing huge aggregate spikes and Dedicated capacity is getting saturated. We need a quick routing/quota mitigation to isolate replays.
aj: ugh. do we know if this is because the replay jobs used the same route tag as live? :thinking_face:
maria: yeah, they used the same route key. replay worker set didn't set intent header so smart-routing treated them as normal requests.
ken: can we carve a replay-only quota pool? replay jobs -> replay-pool, no cross-consumption of reserved tenants.
nora: big +1. also we should prevent recompute aggregates from landing in the primary console until they pass a small validation — customers are seeing noisy spikes.
samir: short-term: add an X-Replay-Intent: true header and middleware rule to route to replay-backend. I can push a hotfix to the routing layer in ~2h.
aj: that gets us off the live pool quick. we should also add a priority-lane flag so critical low-latency traffic preempts replay when needed.
ken: agree. policy detail: replay jobs should be in a preemptible class with strict concurrency cap per tenant, and a per-cluster quota so it can't exhaust Dedicated capacity.
ora: UI piece: add a "hide recompute results" toggle in Console -> Telemetry (default off for internal users). then a separate preview view that shows recompute diffs only for owners.
console-bot: added feature-flag ticket #PLT-792 to track "console.recompute_preview". Owners: @ken, @nora.
dev-bot: alert: backfill-job-42 started 4471234578, live-requests spiked 4.8x; dropping job until routing patch applied.
maria: good, let's pause remaining jobs. Samir: please scope the middleware change + unit tests and a rollout plan with a canary.
samir: will do. plan: patch routing middleware -> deploy to staging -> canary in eu-west -> flip for replay cluster. add header checks and reject if header missing.
aj: for safety add server-side validation in the job launcher so future replays always include the header. maybe fail fast if missing.
ken: i'll add the quota pool and the preempt policy in the cluster config. can we set a conservative cap: 10% of Dedicated capacity per region for replays for next 48h?
maria: 10% sounds fine for now. also let's record a short postmortem in incidents once resolved.
aj: owners: samir (routing hotfix), ken (quota/policy), nora (console UX), maria (coord). timeline: samir 2h, ken 3h, console patch next-day.
maria: thanks. pausing remaining backfills now. react with :thumbsup: when you pick up your task.
aj: :thumbsup:
ken: :thumbsup:
samir: on it.
nora: grabbing console task.
maria: I'll assemble a quick runbook for re-running backfills safely after guards in place.
